title: Conformance attestation payload
description: The payload of a BACP conformance attestation: a compact JWS, with the JOSE header typ bacp-conformance+jwt, signed by a key of a conformance authority that appears in the public conformance-authority list. It records that the subject passed the listed conformance levels and, for a gateway, which pilot payment handlers it may offer. It is a statement about passing BACP protocol tests. It is not approval, certification or onboarding by NPCI, RBI, ONDC or any public body, and it MUST NOT be presented as such. The payload cannot express these rules, which the conformance cases test: exp is at most 180 days after iat; iss is not operated by the same operator as sub, as the payer PSP named in rail_binding.psp_id or as the issuing Mandate Manager; sub is the subscriber that the signing key of the forwarded request resolves to in the registry.

iss.description: The conformance authority: the ca_id of the entry in the public conformance-authority list whose key signed this attestation.

sub.description: The participant that the attestation is about: the gateway's subscriber id, the agent id or the Mandate Manager's registry id, as subject_role says.

subject_role.description: What the subject is. Only a gateway may list pilot handlers.

scope.description: Fixed value. It states that the attestation covers BACP protocol conformance and nothing else.

iat.description: Issue time, as a NumericDate (seconds since the epoch, RFC 7519 section 4.1.4).

exp.description: Expiry time, as a NumericDate. After it, no verifier may rely on the attestation. It is at most 180 days after iat; a conformance case tests this because JSON Schema cannot compare two fields.

jti.description: Unique id of this attestation. A mandate's rail_binding.conformance records it, and a pause for a lapsed attestation logs it.

bacp_version.description: The dated BACP release (YYYY-MM-DD) whose conformance cases were run.

registry_version.description: The dated release (YYYY-MM-DD) of the handler registry that the run used.

pilots.description: The canonical ids of the pilot payment handlers whose cases the gateway passed and that it may offer. Empty when there are none, and always empty unless subject_role is gateway. A legacy alias is not a canonical id.

manifest_digest.description: Digest of the conformance-case manifest that was run, as sha-256:<base64url>.

report_digest.description: Digest of the published, reproducible run report behind this attestation, as sha-256:<base64url>. The authority's report_uri_template in the public list says where the report is published.

status.description: Where the attestation's revocation status is published. A Mandate Manager and a gateway refuse issuance and a new complete on a pilot handler when the status is revoked (reason binding_ineligible; at a re-check the mandate is paused) or when their copy of the status list is more than 24 hours old or the list is unreachable (reason attestation_status_stale; recoverable, no pause).

StatusListRef.description: The location of a revocation status: a status list uri and the index idx of the entry in it, the same shape as an AgentCredential's status.
